title: DMG_HE_IF: prediction of spatial protein markers from H&E for "Mapping the Tumor Microenvironment of Pediatric Diffuse Midline Glioma using a Spatial Proteomic Atlas with AI-Based Application"
description: Code accompanying the article "Mapping the Tumor Microenvironment of Pediatric Diffuse Midline Glioma using a Spatial Proteomic Atlas with AI-Based Application". The pipeline predicts the presence of marker-positive cells for 22 multiplexed immunofluorescence markers in 100 µm tiles of virtual H&E images of a pediatric brain tumor tissue microarray, using pathology foundation-model embeddings (UNI, Virchow, Prov-GigaPath, CTransPath, RetCCL, REMEDIS) and lightGBM classifiers.
